950-2645-3430-5928.description:
Activate Balduvian Trading Post by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Balduvian Trading Post
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

147-653-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-653-8095.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4247-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4247-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1981-2415-2842-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

619-943-2203-2597-4235.easyPrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Guildless Commons.
619-943-2203-2597-4235.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding two mana.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding two additional mana.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Dormant Volcano.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Dormant Volcano.
Repeat.

1409-3099-6006-7175.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

4644-5821-7791.description:
Activate Fyndhorn Elder by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Fyndhorn Elder.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Fyndhorn Elder.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

598-1982-2452.description:
Activate Liliana's third ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie cards from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sidisi either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Sidisi enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Sidisi triggers, causing you to search your library for a card and put it into your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

423-1437-2895-3861.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-2895-3861.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Uro spell three times.
Resolve the first Uro copy.
The Uro token enters the battlefield, triggering both of its abilities.
Resolve the first Uro ability, sacrificing it. 
Resolve the other Uro ability, gaining 3 life, drawing a card, and putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

252-2054-2440-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it. It will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
When the Improvised Arsenal token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Dinosaur you control.
If needed, activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
252-2054-2440-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more Dinosaurs as the combo begins. You should perform step 3 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool.

789-2921-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
789-2921-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Gutter Grime and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
789-2921-7084.notes: As Gutter Grime will get more and more slime counters, the final token you make will be infinitely large.

773-1308-1409.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve the Galazeth Prismari trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

977-1020-1306-2866-4659.description:
Announce the activation of Chromatic Star's ability, allowing you to activate mana abilities while delaying any triggered abilities until this ability has finished resolving.
Activate Mana Crypt's mana ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing Mana Crypt, Myr Retriever, and Krark-Clan Ironworks, adding six colorless mana.
Complete the activation of Chromatic Star by paying {1}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
When the artifacts go to the graveyard in steps 3 and 4, Myr Retriever triggers once, Scrap Trawler triggers four times, and Chromatic Star triggers once.
Resolve Chromatic Star's triggered ability, drawing a card.
Resolve Myr Retriever's triggered ability, returning Krark-Clan Ironworks from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Scrap Trawler's triggered ability from Krark-Clan Ironworks, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Scrap Trawler's triggered ability from Myr Retriever, returning Chromatic Star from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Scrap Trawler's triggered ability from Chromatic Star, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
The final Scrap Trawler triggered ability from Mana Crypt fails to resolve due to lack of targets.
Cast Krak-Clan Ironworks, Myr Retriver, Chromatic Star, and Mana Crypt by paying seven mana.
Repeat.
977-1020-1306-2866-4659.notes: The purpose the delay mentioned in step 1 is to wait until all relevant artifacts are in your graveyard before you have to select targets for triggered abilities.

454-1978-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
454-1978-5457.description:
Cause Selvala to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat from step 2.

1395-3755-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha and Traxos trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Traxos trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

2232-6472-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-6472-6749.description:
Cast Deceptive Frostkite by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Deceptive Frostkite enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Deceptive Frostkite from the battlefield to your hand.
When Deceptive Frostkite leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Deceptive Frostkite from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

907-5451-5702-6763.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
907-5451-5702-6763.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1306-2645-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Mana Crypt's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
1306-2645-3918.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

2018-2292-4053.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature that does not have flying.
2018-2292-4053.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature without flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3951-5686-5703-5744.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-5686-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

856-1808-4321-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding {R}.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue and Food token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

4186-5445-5686.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
4186-5445-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
4186-5445-5686.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 3.

643-997-1238-2351-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

2-1270-5637.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers, creating six 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate four Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

352-2713-4539.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
352-2713-4539.description:
Cast Unexpected Windfall by paying {2}{R}{R} and discarding a card.
Holding priority, activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {U}{R}, copying Unexpected Windfall.
Resolve the copy of Unexpected Windfall, creating two Treasure artifact tokens and causing you to draw two cards.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2438-3047.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

678-710-2034-3499-4445.description:
Activate Danitha by tapping it, adding {4}{W} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding {C}{C}.
When Danitha dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Danitha to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Danitha by paying {4}{W}.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Leyline Immersion onto the battlefield from your graveyard attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

1762-2034-2144-3613.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
1762-2034-2144-3613.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wilhelt, adding {C}{C}.
When Wilhelt dies, Myrkul triggers, exiling Wilhelt from your graveyard and creating a token copy of Wilhelt that is an enchantment.
Cast Dress Down by paying {1}{U}.
When Dress Down enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Zombie, {C}{C}.
When the Zombie dies, the Wilhelt token triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed, which becomes a 1/1 Zombie without decayed due to Dress Down.
Repeat from step 5.

396-2034-3129-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
396-2034-3129-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
The nontoken creature enters the battlefield, triggering Blessed Sanctuary, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Unicorn tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1679-1722-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1679-1722-2034.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Dire Undercurrents' first ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dire Undercurrents trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-3265-3809-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3265-3809-4871.description:
Activate Dockside Chef by paying {1}{B} and sacrificing a creature.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Dockside Chef ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
